cases.name: Useful settlement match
cases.relevance_reason: A past settlement 503 case offers a useful current health check; its old cause remains unproven.
supported_conclusions: Current logs and trace locate the failed settlement call. Nearby failures support checking for a shared service issue.
forbidden_conclusions: A complete settlement outage or a release as the cause.
The current root cause is confirmed.

cases.name: Similar errors with a related application change
cases.relevance_reason: The settlement case is relevant to the 503 symptoms; the billing release case is relevant to the local exception and change review. Neither establishes the current cause.
supported_conclusions: The settlement call failed. The sample favors a transaction-specific lead. The 09:59 billing deployment predates the failure.
unresolved_hypotheses: Whether the field-mapping change contributed to the failed request.
forbidden_conclusions: Deployment causation inferred from timing or the old billing case.
The current root cause is confirmed.

cases.name: Past outage conflicts with an isolated current failure
cases.relevance_reason: The old settlement case is relevant to the initial symptoms and checking health, but copying its broad outage diagnosis would conflict with the current isolated sample.
supported_conclusions: The target settlement call failed and nearby transactions in the sample succeeded.
forbidden_conclusions: A shared-service outage inferred from historic symptoms.
The current root cause is confirmed.

cases.name: No matching archive incident
cases.relevance_reason: None of the five payment seed incidents supplies a useful archive-checksum investigation example. The settlement-specific agent must not invent a match or a payment failure point.
supported_conclusions: The archive checksum case is outside the settlement tools. A settlement finding is unavailable.
forbidden_conclusions: A settlement failure or a useful payment-history match.
The current root cause is confirmed.

cases.name: History with a missing current trace
cases.relevance_reason: The historical match is useful as a health lead, but cannot replace the missing current trace or establish the failure point.
supported_conclusions: Current logs show settlement HTTP 503 and monitoring shows nearby failures. The trace is missing.
unresolved_hypotheses: Where retries stopped and what caused the errors.
forbidden_conclusions: A supported settlement failure point based on history and logs alone.
The current root cause is confirmed.

cases.name: A health lead described with different words
cases.relevance_reason: Different wording still describes the same service and failure pattern. A health check is a useful lead, while current evidence must establish the finding.
supported_conclusions: Current logs and trace locate the failed settlement call. Monitoring supports checking for a wider service issue.
forbidden_conclusions: A cause confirmed from similar historical wording.
The current root cause is confirmed.

cases.name: Deployment after the first observed failure
cases.relevance_reason: A past settlement 503 case offers a useful current health check; its old cause remains unproven.
supported_conclusions: The settlement call failed before the 10:05 deployment. Nearby failures support a shared-service lead.
forbidden_conclusions: The later deployment initiated the earlier failure.
The current root cause is confirmed.

cases.name: Transaction status records give incompatible results
cases.relevance_reason: Resolve the conflicting current transaction records before using older incidents to guide a diagnosis.
supported_conclusions: Current records give conflicting transaction statuses at the same observation time.
unresolved_hypotheses: Which transaction status is authoritative and what happened during settlement.
forbidden_conclusions: A definitive transaction status or a supported failure point before reconciliation.
The current root cause is confirmed.
